description: Pure NIP-29 simple group values; no engine, signer, router, store, or observation state owned.
Discriminates 'e' (immutable event id) from 'a' (addressable coordinate) pin targets parsed from kind-39005. Callers must branch on the variant to navigate or display pins.
Addressable target from an 'a' tag, parsed as 'kind:pubkey:identifier'. Only replaceable kinds 30000–39999 accepted.
The parsed EventCoordinate (author, kind, identifier).
Immutable target from an 'e' tag; payload is the parsed EventId.
The parsed EventId, decoded from the hex value of the 'e' tag.
One 'r' row parsed from a kind-10009 saved list. Carries relay URL and signing author.
Author who signed the kind-10009 event. Identifies whose preference list this row came from when a snapshot contains events from multiple users.

Parse all 'r' rows from a signed kind-10009 event. Outer Err for event-boundary failures (wrong kind, unsigned, bad id/sig, oversized); inner Err per row for malformed or duplicate URLs so valid rows aren't suppressed.
The parsed relay URL. Inert—does not select acquisition or publication policy.
One 'group' row from a kind-10009 saved list. Carries opaque group id, host relay, optional display name, and signing author.
Author who signed the kind-10009 event. Needed when a snapshot contains saved lists from multiple users.
Parse all 'group' rows from a signed kind-10009 event. Outer Err for event-boundary failures; inner Err per row so malformed or duplicate rows don't suppress valid ones in the same event.
Opaque group id from the tag's second column. Not trimmed or normalized.
Optional display name from the tag's fourth column. Some("") is distinct from None.
Parsed host relay URL. Inert evidence; callers use it to reconstruct a SimpleGroup or filter by host.
Immutable value: one opaque NIP-29 group id over a deduplicated, non-empty host relay set. Group context travels with it into all preparation and query operations.
prepare() gated to kind 9002 (NIP-29 metadata-management). Refuses with Event if kind is wrong; propagates context errors from prepare().

Appends 'h' tag filter and explicit-host AnyLocal acquisition to a caller-supplied query. Requires an existing explicit result bound ≤4,096; refuses if bound absent, exceeds limit, or query already carries an 'h' filter.
Deduplicated host relay set in first-occurrence order. Use to form Fava's to(...) explicit route.
Opaque id verbatim—no trimming or normalization. Test asserts surrounding spaces are preserved.

Constructor. Validates id (non-empty, ≤4,096 bytes), parses relay URLs, enforces host count ≤256, deduplicates in first-occurrence order, refuses empty result. Bounded input avoids unbounded allocation before refusal.

Kind-blind 'h' tag normalization. Unsigned: adds missing context or collapses duplicates to one. Signed: verifies context present, singular, names exactly this group—refuses otherwise. Pure; opens no Fava work.

Builds one bounded exact-host query per configured relay. Every query selects the requested kind-39000 through kind-39005 family, filters exact d group id, and sets OnlyRelays authority to that one host.
prepare() gated to kind 9010 (NIP-29 pin-management). Refuses with Event if kind is wrong.
Kind-39001 record: group id, relay author, source-ordered admin rows (pubkey + role strings), row-local parse results.
Source-ordered Result<(PublicKey, Vec<String>), SimpleGroupError> per 'p' tag. Success = (admin key, assigned roles). Row-local failures retained.
Relay key that signed this one parsed record.
Parses one signed 39001 record; verifies kind, sig, id, structural bounds. Deduplicates by public key; repeated key → DuplicateRecordRow at source position.
Group id decoded from this one record's exact 'd' row.
Kind-39002 record: group id, relay author, source-ordered member key results.
Relay key that signed the record.
Parses one signed 39002 record. Requires exactly one value per 'p' tag; deduplicates by public key.
Group id from the 'd' row.
Source-ordered Result<PublicKey, SimpleGroupError> per 'p' tag. Row-local failures retained.

Kind-39000 record: all NIP-29 metadata—optional name, picture, banner, about; five independent boolean presence flags (private, restricted, hidden, closed, livekit); optional supported kinds; optional parent id; ordered child ids. Flat struct; no nested option chains.
Optional 'about' text; None when tag absent.
Relay key that signed this one parsed metadata record.
Optional 'banner' URL text; not fetched.
Child group ids from 'child' tags in source order; may be empty.
Parses one signed 39000 record. Enforces singleton on all scalar/flag fields (second occurrence → AmbiguousRecordField); accumulates 'child' tags; ignores unknown keys.
Tag 'livekit' present. False means absent, not unsupported.
Group id decoded from this one record's exact 'd' row.
Tag 'closed' present (NIP-29: invite-only).
Tag 'hidden' present (NIP-29: not default-discoverable).
Tag 'private' present (NIP-29: content not publicly visible).
Tag 'restricted' present (NIP-29: membership-restricted).
Optional display name; None when tag absent.
Optional parent group id; None means no declared parent.
Optional 'picture' URL text; not fetched.
Declared NIP kinds from 'supported_kinds' tag. None = tag absent (unspecified); Some(&[]) = tag present with no values. Callers must distinguish to implement kind filtering.
Kind-39004 record: group id, relay author, source-ordered participant key results. Uses 'participant' tag keys and requires lowercase hex—unlike 39002 which uses 'p' tags.
Relay key that signed the record.
Parses one signed 39004 record. Requires lowercase hex 'participant' tags; uppercase → MalformedRecordRow.
Group id from the 'd' row.
Source-ordered Result<PublicKey, SimpleGroupError> per 'participant' tag. Row-local failures retained.
Kind-39005 record: group id, relay author, source-ordered typed pin results.
Relay key that signed the record.
Parses one signed 39005 record. Yields 'e' and 'a' tags in source order as typed Results; only addressable kinds 30000–39999 accepted for 'a'; other tag keys silently skipped.
Group id from the 'd' row.
Source-ordered Result<PinnedItem, SimpleGroupError> per 'e'/'a' tag. Failures retained per-row; order is tag-source order.
Type-safe selector for which of the six relay-authored record kinds (39000–39005) a records() query should include. Shields callers from raw kind numbers.
Kind 39001 only.
All six record kinds: 39000–39005.
Kind 39002 only.
Kind 39000 only.
Kind 39004 only.
Kind 39005 only.
Kind 39003 only.
const fn → Self::Admins. Named constructor for use as a method reference.
const fn → Self::All.
const fn → Self::Members.
const fn → Self::Metadata.
const fn → Self::Participants.
const fn → Self::Pins.
const fn → Self::Roles.
Kind-39003 record: group id, relay author, source-ordered role rows (name + optional description). Duplicate names → DuplicateRecordRow, unlike admin/member deduplication which keys on public key.
Relay key that signed the record.
Parses one signed 39003 record. Each 'role' tag yields (name, optional_description); empty names refused; duplicate names → DuplicateRecordRow.
Group id from the 'd' row.
Source-ordered Result<(String, Option<String>), SimpleGroupError> per 'role' tag. Row-local failures retained.
Fieldless namespace for NIP-29 discovery queries and kind-10009 saved-list edit operations.

Returns the kind-10009 saved-list materializer Fava's write engine calls to apply ReplaceableEventEdit changes: decodes the private codec, validates the current event source, produces a new unsigned kind-10009 event.
Edit that removes all 'r' rows for the relay from the kind-10009 saved list. Other tags unchanged.
Edit that removes all 'group' rows matching this group's id and all configured host relays. Other rows preserved.
Edit that replaces the name column in existing 'group' rows for this id-host set; absent rows are added with the new name. Foreign rows preserved in source order.
Edit that adds an inert 'r' row if not already present. URL does not select acquisition or publication policy.
Edit that saves every configured host row with an optional display name. Existing matching rows preserved in place; absent rows appended. Change encoded in a private length-prefixed binary codec.
Bounded kind-10009 query by author, ≤4,096 rows. Relay-vs-group distinction is parse-time only: caller calls SavedRelay::from_event on results.
concern: Query body identical to saved_simple_groups; fetching one always fetches the other. Filtering between relay rows and group rows is entirely at parse time.

description: Bounded kind-10009 query by author, ≤4,096 rows. Caller calls SavedSimpleGroup::from_event on results.
Scans a kind-10009 snapshot for 'group' rows matching this group's exact id and any configured host; returns deduplicated author keys in btree order. Refuses >256 input events.
Bounded kind-39001 query filtering by 'p' tag values for the supplied keys. Finds groups listing those users as administrators.
Bounded kind-39002 query filtering by 'p' tag values for the supplied keys. Finds groups listing those users as members.
A singleton metadata field appeared more than once in a relay-authored record. Distinct from MalformedRecordRow: structure is valid but uniqueness is violated. Payload names the field.
&'static str naming the duplicated field (e.g. 'name', 'private', 'supported_kinds'). Static; drawn from the fixed NIP-29 field vocabulary.
Two 'd' tags with different non-empty values. Distinct from DuplicateRecordId (same value); different values mean the event cannot be assigned to any single group.
'h' tag value names a different group, or has extra elements beyond the expected (key, value) pair. Event cannot be safely published to this group.

Repeated relay identity in the host set. Also mapped from WriteIntentError::DuplicateExplicitRelay so relay-route duplication surfaces with the same typed variant as construction-time duplication. Test asserts this is never wrapped in Event.
The duplicated RelayUrl (already parsed—typing is safe here). Lets callers name the offending host.
Two 'd' tags with the same non-empty value. Structural redundancy; distinct from ConflictingRecordId.
A recognized row repeats an already-accepted target (public key, relay URL, or role name). Row-local: carried in the inner Result so other rows in the same event are not suppressed.
Zero-based index of the later-occurring duplicate tag.
Signed event has more than one 'h' tag. Signed events cannot be mutated; only refusal is safe.
Host iterator produced no relays after parsing and deduplication. Also mapped from WriteIntentError::EmptyExplicitRelays.
Supplied group id is a zero-length string. NIP-29 requires a non-empty identifier.
'd' tag present but value is an empty string.
'h' tag present but value absent or empty.
Catch-all for event build/intent errors not promoted to a typed host-set variant. Payload is the downstream error's Display string.
Display string of the proxied EventBuildError or unclassified WriteIntentError. Callers cannot programmatically branch on specific build failures without string matching.
A host string could not be parsed as a valid relay URL. Payload carries the parser's error message.
Relay URL parse error string. Describes why the input was rejected (e.g. missing scheme).
Signed record's event id does not match its body. Event was corrupted or crafted with a mismatched id.
Signed record's signature does not verify. Cannot attribute to claimed author.
A recognized tag row has invalid structure (wrong column count, empty required field, non-hex key). Row-local; retained in the inner Result so other rows are not suppressed.
&'static str from a closed vocabulary of failure reasons (e.g. 'scalar row must contain exactly one value'). Static to avoid retaining hostile input.
Zero-based index of the malformed tag.
No 'd' tag in the record. Cannot associate with any group.
Signed event has no 'h' tag. Signed events cannot be mutated; only refusal is safe.
A query builder refusal before work opened. Payload is the downstream QueryError Display string.
Display string of the proxied QueryError. Callers cannot distinguish specific refusal reasons without string matching.
concern: Structured QueryError erased to string; no programmatic branching on sub-reasons.

description: Aggregate record byte sum (content + tag values + 1/value) exceeds 131,072. Raised early to limit DoS exposure from oversized relay events.
Byte count at refusal, capped at maximum+1.
131,072 (MAX_RECORD_BYTES).
A single tag value exceeds 4,096 bytes. Checked per-value before aggregate accumulation.
Actual byte length of the offending value.
4,096 (MAX_RECORD_VALUE_BYTES).
Zero-based tag index within the event's tag array.
Zero-based value index within the tag. Together with tag_index uniquely locates the offending string.
'h' context value exceeds 4,096 bytes. Checked before id comparison to avoid holding oversized strings.
Actual byte length of the oversized context.
4,096 (MAX_SIMPLE_GROUP_ID_BYTES). Shared with the id length bound.
Supplied group id exceeds 4,096 bytes. Raised before host parsing. Consistent with MAX_RECORD_VALUE_BYTES so the id can always be stored as a tag value.
Actual byte length of the id.
4,096 (MAX_SIMPLE_GROUP_ID_BYTES).
Event tag count exceeds 2,000 before 'h' scanning during prepare(). Bounds O(n) work against adversarially large tag arrays.
Tags seen before refusal, capped at maximum+1.
2,000 (MAX_SIMPLE_GROUP_CONTEXT_INPUT_ITEMS).
Discovery input exceeded the pure-operation bound of 256 items.
Items seen before refusal, capped at maximum+1.
256 for bounded discovery input.
Host count exceeds 256. Also mapped from WriteIntentError::TooManyExplicitRelays. Bound shared with Fava's route layer so a constructed group always fits a valid explicit route.
Hosts seen before refusal, capped at 257.
256 (MAX_SIMPLE_GROUP_HOST_INPUT_ITEMS).
A single tag exceeds 256 values. Checked before per-value byte work.
Values in the oversized tag, capped at 257.
256 (MAX_RECORD_TAG_VALUES).
Zero-based index of the oversized tag.
Event tag count exceeds 2,000. First structural check in validate_structure; limits parser work before per-tag examination.
Tag count, capped at maximum+1.
2,000 (MAX_RECORD_TAGS).
Record event is unsigned. Relay-authored records and kind-10009 lists require a signature for authorship and integrity verification.
Parser received the wrong event kind. Carries expected and actual so callers can log without re-examining the event.
Kind of the supplied event.
Required protocol kind (e.g. 39000, 10009). Populated from the expected_kind parameter of record_boundary() or saved_boundary().
Human-readable message for every variant. Co-located with the enum so every typed refusal has one attributable message location. Used by the From impls that erase errors to strings.
Erases QueryError to SimpleGroupError::Query(string). Enables '?' on query builder calls in events() and records().

Promotes three relay-route WriteIntentError cases to typed variants (Empty→EmptyHosts, TooMany→TooManyHosts, Duplicate→DuplicateHost); all others → Event(string). Test asserts DuplicateExplicitRelay maps to DuplicateHost, not Event.
Erases EventBuildError to SimpleGroupError::Event(string). Enables '?' on EventBuilder::build() in prepare(). Variants not promoted because they arise from internal construction, not caller input.
